# BrainRush

> BrainRush is a free trivia game for a group around one shared screen, played in the browser. One person hosts: they read each question out, listen to the spoken answers and mark them right or wrong. Players or teams pick questions from a board of categories and point values, and harder questions are worth more points.

- Up to 6 players or 4 teams, each with their own color.
- A correct answer adds the question's points, a wrong one takes them away.
- One random question on each board is secretly worth double points for a correct answer; a popup reveals it when it is opened.
- Every question has a countdown timer, and a speaker button can read it aloud with the device's own voices.
- When players are tied for first at the end, an optional "Golden Goal" tiebreaker follows: everyone secretly bets points on one more question, up to their score or the board's top point value, whichever is higher, and it repeats while the tie lasts.
- Each player or team has 3 helpers per game: 3 choices, Swap (a random new question) and Skip (lose only half the points).
- Playing alone, the Streak Challenge asks multiple-choice questions from every category until the first wrong answer or time's up; the longest streaks go on a shared top-10 leaderboard under the challenger name the player enters, for this week (Monday to Sunday, UTC) and of all time.
- The Daily Challenge gives everyone the same 3 multiple-choice questions each day (a new set at midnight UTC); the result, such as "BrainRush Daily #12: 2/3" with a row of green and red squares, can be shared, as can the final standings of a board game.
- Many questions are in Arabic and English, and some show a picture, such as a flag or a famous place.
- The game itself can be shown in English or Arabic (right to left) with the EN / AR switch in its header; the choice is saved on the device.
- Each device remembers which questions it has played, so new games pick unseen questions first.
- No sign-up or install. It works best on a TV or big screen with the host at the keyboard.

This file lists no questions or answers, on purpose.

## Play

- [Play BrainRush](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/): set up players or teams, pick categories and start a game
- [How to play](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/how-to-play.html): player guide covering setup, the board, answering, scoring, helpers, ending the game, the Golden Goal tiebreaker, the Streak Challenge and the Daily Challenge

## Optional

- [Categories](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/api/categories.php): JSON list of the current categories and how many questions each has
- [About](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/about.html): what BrainRush is, who makes it and how the questions are made
- [Contact](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/contact.html): email for corrections, ideas and data requests
- [Terms of Service](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/terms.html): rules for using the site
- [Privacy Policy](https://brainrush.integration.ninja/privacy.html): what the game saves, and how the Google AdSense ads on the Streak leaderboard screen use cookies
